question: Which wildlife area has been recently recognised as India’s 107th national park?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Similipal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Similipal National Park**, located in the state of **Odisha**, has recently been recognized as India’s **107th National Park**, adding to the country’s list of protected wildlife areas.
 
• Similipal derives its name from the abundance of **Simul trees (silk cotton trees)** found in the region.
 
• It was earlier designated as a **Tiger Reserve** in 1973 under Project Tiger and has been a **Biosphere Reserve** since 1994.
 
• This park is renowned for its rich biodiversity, which includes unique species such as the **Royal Bengal Tiger**, **Asian elephant**, and Indian bison, among others.
 
• The park also boasts **beautiful landscapes** and features **waterfalls** like Barehipani and Joranda, dense forests, and a variety of flora and fauna.
 
• Recognizing Similipal as a National Park strengthens its conservation status, ensuring further protection of its ecosystems and wildlife.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Similipal National Park Features:**

 
 
• Spread over an area of **2,750 square kilometers**, Similipal is one of the largest National Parks in India.
 
• The park hosts over **94 species of orchids** and more than **3,000 species of plants**, making it a haven for botanists.
 
• Similipal is home to over **55 mammal species**, **304 bird species**, **60 reptile species**, and numerous amphibians and insects.
 
• The park is part of the **Mayurbhanj district** in Odisha and forms an important part of the Eastern Ghats biodiversity hotspot.
 
 
 
• **Other National Parks in India:**
 
 
• India has a total of **107 National Parks**, and each plays a critical role in wildlife conservation.
 
• Some prominent National Parks include **Jim Corbett National Park** (Uttarakhand), **Kaziranga National Park** (Assam), **Sundarbans National Park** (West Bengal), and **Gir National Park** (Gujarat).
 
• Each park is vital for preserving the unique ecosystems and biodiversity of its region.
 
 
 
• **Importance of National Parks:**
 
 
• National Parks serve as protected areas to conserve **endangered species** and their habitats.
 
• They help in maintaining **ecological balance** and contribute to climate regulation.
 
• They provide opportunities for **eco-tourism**, promoting awareness and sustainable development.
 
• National Parks also play a significant role in **scientific research** and biodiversity studies.
 
 
 
• **Key Characteristics of Other Options:**
 
 
• **Buxa Tiger Reserve:** Located in West Bengal, it is known for its diverse fauna and is a critical tiger habitat.
 
• **Nagarhole National Park:** Situated in Karnataka, it is part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve and is famous for its population of tigers and elephants.
 
• **Palamau Tiger Reserve:** Located in Jharkhand, it is one of India’s first tiger reserves established under Project Tiger.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legal Framework for National Parks:**

 
 
• National Parks are governed under the **Wildlife Protection Act of 1972**, ensuring legal protection for wildlife and their habitats.
 
• Activities like hunting, poaching, and deforestation are strictly prohibited in National Parks.
 
• The Ministry of Environment, Forest, and Climate Change oversees the management and expansion of National Parks.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Challenges:**
 
 
• Encroachment, deforestation, and human-wildlife conflicts are significant threats to National Parks.
 
• Climate change impacts biodiversity and ecosystems within protected areas.
 
• Government initiatives like Project Tiger and Project Elephant aim to address these challenges and strengthen conservation efforts.
